commit_message:
[wasm][deoptimizer] Resolve feedback vector in WasmLiftoffDeoptFinish only

Previously the deoptimizer would try to lookup the feedback vector in
the vector of feedback vectors in the wasm trusted instance.
This was implemented at a time when I still assumed that there will
always be a valid feedback vector, however due to multi-instance
scenarios, this turned out to be incorrect. Later on this was fixed in
the WasmLiftoffDeoptFinish to allocate and fill in those feedback
vectors for which we didn't find one yet.

Moving the lookup of the feedback vector to the builtin exclusively
simplifies the code and also removes an access to the heap from within
the deoptimizer (which we'd ideally reduce down to zero if possible).

fix_commit.message: [runtime][wasm] Fix --trace-deopt-verbose using the wrong kind of index
fix_commit.author: Matthias Liedtke

findings.title: Wrong function-index kind passed to NativeModule::GetCode() in wasm deopt tracing
findings.message: In Runtime_WasmLiftoffDeoptFinish, when v8_flags.trace_deopt_verbose is enabled and a feedback vector needs to be allocated, the code calls trusted_instance_data->native_module()->GetCode(declared_func_index). However, declared_func_index is already the index relative to the first *declared* (non-imported) wasm function (it was decoded directly from the Smi stored in the liftoff frame's feedback-vector slot). NativeModule::GetCode(uint32_t index) expects a *module-scoped* function index (including imports) and internally converts it via declared_function_index(module(), index), which subtracts module->num_imported_functions again. Passing an already-declared index therefore causes a second, erroneous subtraction of num_imported_functions, producing a negative or otherwise wrong index used to access code_table_[...]. In debug builds this trips the DCHECK_LE/DCHECK_GT assertions inside declared_function_index(); in release builds (where DCHECKs are compiled out) it results in an out-of-bounds read into the NativeModule's code_table_ vector, which can crash the process or leak adjacent heap memory contents through code->DebugName() in the trace output. The same wrong index is also printed in the PrintF diagnostic message, misreporting the actual function.
findings.suggestion: Convert declared_func_index into a module-scoped function index before calling GetCode(), matching the convention used elsewhere (e.g. int module_func_index = trusted_instance_data->native_module()->num_imported_functions() + declared_func_index;), and use that value both for GetCode() and for the printed index.

ground_truth.root_cause: Two different kinds of wasm function indices exist in V8's codebase: the 'declared function index' (excludes imported functions) and the 'module function index' (includes imported functions). NativeModule::GetCode() expects the latter and performs its own conversion via declared_function_index(). The introducing commit passed the already-declared index directly to GetCode() without converting it back to a module-scoped index, causing the conversion to be applied twice.

must_cover.reason: Primary location of finding: Wrong function-index kind passed to NativeModule::GetCode() in wasm deopt tracing
